During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces '''assaulted''' the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Edan Base]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. Led by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']], Imperial forces attacked Edan Base in force, overwhelming it and forcing surviving Alliance personnel to scatter into the surrounding areas.
